description: Search the domain names PendingDelete.net follows: in pending delete (the default) — the last five days before a registry deletes a name and anyone can register it — or, with status, the names released in the last 90 days: available (nobody has registered them again: anyone can register them now), caught (registered again since), or released (still being checked). The same filters as the site's advanced search: a keyword (contains, starts with, ends with, exact, doesn't contain) or a regular expression, words to leave out, a letter pattern, length, hyphens, numbers, IDN, extensions, adjoining .com/.net/.org registered, the drop or release date, confirmed drop times only, registrar, the year first registered, Linking Domains, Rank, real words, people's names and syllables. Each name comes with its drop (or release) date and time (US Eastern), length, registrar, registration date, Linking Domains and Rank (Common Crawl's web graph — not Moz DA or Ahrefs DR), which of the same name's .com, .net and .org are registered, and its page on PendingDelete.net. One answer holds 100 names unless limit says otherwise (up to 100), and the total; page gives the next ones, and each answer links the whole list on the site with its CSV. get_domain looks up one name in any status.

adjoining_registered.description: Adjoining TLDs registered: keep names whose same name is registered right now in each of these, e.g. extensions ["com"] with ["net", "org"] gives the .com names whose .net and .org are both registered (someone owns them: a sign the name is wanted). From the zone files, once a day; .com, .net and .org names only.

confirmed_drop_times_only.description: Only names whose drop time is worked out from the registry's own record of when the name entered pending delete, not estimated.

drop_date_from.description: Drops (pending delete) or was released (the other statuses) on or after this day: YYYY-MM-DD, or yesterday, today or tomorrow (US Eastern).

drop_date_to.description: Drops or was released on or before this day: YYYY-MM-DD, or yesterday, today or tomorrow (US Eastern). The same day in both for one day.

exclude.description: Leave out names containing any of these (up to 5), e.g. ["shop", "247"].

extensions.description: Extensions to search, without the dot, e.g. ["com"] or ["com", "net", "org"]. Leave out for every extension PendingDelete.net tracks; most people want ["com"].

hyphens.description: Include names with hyphens. Default true.

keyword.description: Text to find in the name before the dot: letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. "shop". How it matches is set by match.

letter_pattern.description: The shape of the name before the dot: C a consonant, V a vowel, L any letter, N a digit; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens stand for themselves. E.g. CVCV (like "bobo"), LLLN, go-L.

limit.description: Names in this answer, 1–100 (more than 100 gives 100). Default 100.

match.description: How keyword matches the name before the dot. Default contains.

max_length.description: Most characters before the dot (25 means 25 or more).

mens_names.description: Only names starting with a man's first name (alone, or with a last name and more after it).

min_linking_domains.description: At least this many other domains linking to the name in Common Crawl's web graph (the site's steps: 1, 10, 100, 1000).

min_rank.description: A Rank of at least this (0–10 score of where the name stands in Common Crawl's web graph; see the answers for exactly how it is worked out).

numbers.description: Include names with digits. Default true.

order.description: asc or desc, as the words say (desc: the most Linking Domains, the highest Rank, the newest registration first). Default: nearest drop, A to Z, shortest, most Linking Domains, highest Rank, oldest registration, most adjoining registered.

page.description: Which page of the results, from 1. Pages reach the first 10,000 names.

real_words.description: Only names made of everyday English words — not people's names or places.

regex.description: A regular expression over the name before the dot, used instead of keyword (MySQL REGEXP; letters, digits, - ^ $ . * + ? ( ) [ ] { } | \ and commas; no back-references). E.g. ^[a-z]{4}$ for four letters.

registered_from_year.description: First registered in this year or later.

registered_to_year.description: First registered in this year or earlier, e.g. 2005 for names older than about twenty years.

registrars.description: The registrar the name was with, as the registry writes it (up to 10); the commonest in pending delete now: GoDaddy.com, LLC; NameCheap, Inc.; GMO Internet Group, Inc. d/b/a Onamae.com; Dynadot Inc; GNAME.COM PTE. LTD.; Spaceship, Inc..

single_word.description: Only names that are one everyday English word by themselves (bridge, flights, football) — not two words joined.

sort.description: Order of the names. Default drop_date: the nearest drop first (for the released statuses, the newest release first).

status.description: Which names: pending_delete (the default: they drop within five days), available (released in the last 90 days and not registered again: anyone can register them now), caught (released in the last 90 days and registered again since), or released (released, still being checked). One at a time.

surnames.description: Only last names: alone, after a first name, or first with a trade's words after it (smithlaw).

syllables.description: Exactly this many syllables (real words only).

womens_names.description: Only names starting with a woman's first name.

name: search_domains
